topic.title: History compression with task-conditioned representation
topic.question: Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, can joint history compression and task-conditioned representation improve click AUC over both frozen source bests at justified parameter and measured runtime cost?
topic.hypothesis: History compression and task-conditioned representation may preserve complementary predictive signals. A joint approach should exceed the stronger source when compared with both frozen sources, component replacement controls and matched-capacity alternatives. Failure to exceed the stronger source, or an advantage explained by added capacity or compute, would falsify useful complementarity for the tested implementation; no mechanism is established by the existing summaries.
